Name: Pastel Furniture
Author: BloodyJinxii
Description:
Sick of the boring furniture the game gives you? Want a softer touch? Try pastels!

This mod changes the color scheme of many wood and cloth items to a pastel hue.

Installation:
1. Download the mod,
2. Unzip "BloodyJinxii's Pastel Furniture"
3. Drag the TileSheets folder to Stardew Valley's Content folder.
4. Allow it to override.
5. You're done!
